name: seo-page-structure-checklist
description: Developer checklist for building a website without structural SEO mistakes: HTML, links, robots and noindex, sitemaps, canonical, metadata, structured data (JSON-LD), and multilingual declarations, checked against the English Google Search Central docs with source URLs. Audit a page or build output, ask how-to questions, or plan a page before you build it. Unofficial; not affiliated with Google.
